The first release since 0.1.0 on 4 October, and a big one: Yap now takes meeting notes, works with your calendar, and has a Chat you can type or talk to.

### Meeting notes
- Yap notices a call in Teams, Zoom, Meet or any other app and offers to take notes. You and the others are transcribed separately, on this PC.
- A summary as the meeting goes, an action plan at the end, and a notepad docked beside the call.
- The audio is kept for 14 days: crash recovery, Transcribe again, ▶ any line, Export audio.
- Voices told apart and named (beta); tasks; Ask about the meeting; Skills such as /followup-email and /prep.
- Your calendar (Google or an iCal link): reminders, pre-meeting briefs and folders for recurring meetings.
- Import a transcript from Teams, Zoom, Meet, Otter or Granola.

### Chat and the Voice Assistant
- Chat about your notes and meetings, the web, your calendar and the apps on this PC, on the model you choose: one on this PC, your own API key, or your ChatGPT plan (Sign in with ChatGPT).
- Ask out loud from any app and hear the answer, in a voice on this PC (Kokoro or Windows') or ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Gemini or Groq on your own key.
- Documents and web pages beside the chat, pictures from the web, and search by meaning across your meetings, notes and chats.
- Snip to Chat (Win+Alt+S): drag a box over any screen and ask about it.
- Memory: what Yap learns about you, kept on this PC.
- Yap Link (preview): ask Yap from your phone on your home Wi-Fi.

### Dictation
- The Yap bar: a small pill with a live waveform on the screen you're using.
- AI cleanup in the style of each kind of app, at the strength you choose. See what it changed, and paste what you said instead.
- My languages: dictate in several languages, with a shortcut for a language or a translation.
- Commands: the rewrite shortcut, or a name you give Yap's AI, has it write for you, even a reply to the email on screen. Saved transforms on one key.
- Smarter pasting: Yap checks the paste landed, fits it to the text around the cursor, and knows terminals, chat apps (@mentions) and code editors.
- Snippets, a dictionary that learns from your corrections, the quick note, Read aloud anywhere, your mouse's side buttons and sound packs.

### Also
- A dark theme; Insights (words a minute, streaks); Download your data and Delete some of your data; network receipts; Report a problem.
- The AI on this PC runs on llama.cpp's own builds (CUDA on NVIDIA cards) and keeps itself up to date.
- Updates download by themselves, with notes like these.
- Hundreds of fixes.
